consequence.statement: A new `flux migrate` command is implemented; nothing in the evidence says an operator must act.

original.statement: A new `flux migrate` CLI command was added to the flux CLI; it is a new feature with no stated operational consequence.

decision.reason: [ev-207e01544690] only says a new `flux migrate` CLI command was implemented. It does not say that anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be run, so an operator who does nothing sees no operational change from this addition. Any required migration would be a separate upstream change, not this one. Consequence kind "none" (informational) is therefore supported, though the single changelog line is thin.
